learning_outcomes.text: Understand and use the fundamental physical principles of Electromagnetism in the analysis and study of concepts and in solving problems associated with higher-level courses.
Identify and evaluate the physical aspects related to Electromagnetism present in engineering problems and situations.
Use and relate the different units of measurement for the main physical magnitudes related to Electromagnetism.
Use appropriate measurement instruments for the determination of the most relevant physical parameters in the fields of Electromagnetism.
Acquire experimental skills for verifying physical laws and determining physical parameters.
Know how to document a measurement process concerning its foundation, the instrumentation it requires, and the conditions under which it is valid.
Know how to transmit information, ideas, and conclusions.

assessment_methods.method: Completion of practicals and knowledge evaluation

assessment_rules: The course is evaluated through two written tests (42.5% each) and mandatory, non-recoverable laboratory practicals (15%). A minimum score of 2 points is required in each written test to pass the course. For the recovery examination, its grade accounts for 85% of the final grade, with the remaining 15% from the laboratory practicals.
